notes.title: SHOOPER NOVA S4 Update Preview
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, thank you for your support for SHOOPER NOVA :3, the S4 Season update is coming soon![/p][p](Note: Due to difficulty adjustments and data changes, to ensure fairness and enjoyment of the Ranking,**[b]old game save data will become invalid after the update[/b]**)[/p][p][/p][p]Here are the main update contents:[/p][list][*][p]New Final Battle: After passing Wave 20, a "Final Battle" option is added. Enter an untimed Wave 21, challenge yourself to survive longer and rank (this will use a separate Ranking leaderboard, this option will take less time).[/p][/*][*][p]New Custom Emoji: You can now import local images and display them on your character's face (supports PNG and GIF image formats).[/p][/*][*][p]Trading Cards Enabled: (Cards, Badges, Emotes, Profile Backgrounds, Animated Avatars; it is said that veteran players will be compensated with dropped cards).[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Workshop Enabled.[/p][/*][*][p]Please look forward to more content in the update announcement on the release day :3![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: V1.2.1 Change log
notes.content:
[h1]Leaderboards into the S3 season! [/h1]
As the game's content has changed considerably from the previous version, this update will enter the Leaderboards S3 season for the sake of fairness and fun in the leaderboards!
Thank you to the 11,670 players who fought on the leaderboards during the S2 season! Together we have protected the planet!
[list]
[*] You can go to the Leaderboards interface to switch seasons to see the historical rankings
[*] After the game update, unfinished games from the old version will be deactivated
[/list]

[h1]Thanks to [b]姬酱[/b] for the new original soundtrack![/h1]
To be released soon:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3785540/_SHOOPER_NOVA_Soundtrack]SHOOPER NOVA Original Soundtrack[/url]


[h1]Major Content Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added/modified several techs to enhance the performance of shields/shooting towers/guns/scatter/negative refinement
[*] Modified Satellite related components and techs: increased Satellite base damage, increased Satellite size, reduced Satellite lifespan.
[*] Added component level requirement for most techs that require component count.
[*] Component upgrades will give more damage bonuses.
[*] Component archive can be toggled to view different levels of components.
[*] Enemy archive has been added.
[*] Elite enemies drop 2 money when killed.
[*] Added “Endless Arena”: available at the end of 20 waves, no leaderboards, slower enemy growth, doubled tech stacking limit, more possibilities to explore (former “Endless Trial” renamed to “Extreme Challenge”). 
[/list]

[h1]Attribute Logic Adjustment[/h1]
[list]
[*] Change of reload time to reload speed, the more components on the component ring, the slower the reload speed (non-linear increase)
[*] Convert extra shooting speed to damage when shooting speed overflows
[*] Convert extra crit hit chance to crit hit effect when crit hit chance overflows
[/list]

[h1] Other Optimizations[/h1]
[list]
[*] New corner markers have been added to satellite components, so that you can visualize the orbits set by the satellite components.
[*] When you change the satellite orbit, the result will be recorded, and when you buy the same kind of satellite component, it will be set to the same orbit automatically.
[*] New button “Synchronize orbits of similar satellites with one click” is added next to the satellite orbit button.
[*] Satellite components in close orbits will have a chance to summon satellites that fly close to the earth (even if they have a small radius) so that they can attack enemies close to the earth.
[*] Show number of summons when they exist on the field
[*] Avoid losing damage due to low frame rate.
[*] Avoid not being able to upload leaderboard scores due to enemy blood overflow
[*] Enhance cursor visibility
[/list]

notes.title: SHOOPER NOVA: Upcoming Update Preview
notes.content:
[h1]SHOOPER NOVA is about to receive an update![/h1]
[list]
[*]  Enhanced the power of Weapons/Shields/Towers/Scattering/Negative Refinement, and Satellites will become "bigger"
[*]  Enhanced the importance of Component Levels in mid-to-late game
[*]  Component Archive can view components of various levels
[*]  Added 【Enemy Archive】
[*]  Added 【Endless Proving Ground】, which does not participate in ranking, enemies grow slower, Tech cap is doubled, allowing for exploration of more possibilities
[*]  Original 【Endless Trial】 renamed to 【Extreme Challenge】
[*]  Prevent damage loss under low frame rates
[*]  Ranking will enter S3 Season![b]（Note：Save data for unfinished games will become invalid after the update）[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: V1.1.4 Change Log
notes.content:
[h1]Refresh mechanism adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] Each time you skip purchasing an item, in addition to the item no longer appearing in the next few refreshes, the item's future refresh weight will be reduced by 20%, up to a maximum of 70%, and the reduced refresh weight will be reset once the item is purchased
[/list]


[h1]Other adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] The effect of Refinement Protocol has been halved, the price has been lowered, and it can now be stacked 6 times.
[*] The base price of the Refresh Discount has been slightly increased.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Optimized performance when a large number of bullets pass through the Amplification Shield
[/list]


[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Last fragment of gold mine not counting towards Mining Module
[*] Fixed: Dual screen device dragging and dropping a window to another screen does not set full screen
[*] Fixed: Startup screen volume not following in-game volume settings
[*] Fixed: Projectile module does not reduce damage from Firearm/Mechanical/Elemental/Asteroid damage when reducing damage
[*] Fixed: Fast moving enemies occasionally pass through shields
[/list]

notes.title: V1.1.3 Change Log
notes.content:
[h1]Refresh mechanic adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] If a component/tech has a chance of appearing in the store, but doesn't show up in this refresh, it gets an additional stackable refresh weight on subsequent refreshes until it shows up
[/list]

[h1]Other adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] Nerfed Elite enemies that roam around the edge and fire 2 rounds by 25% of blood
[*] For gun components, if the bullet count is greater than 1, the maximum scatter angle of the first shot is only 1/3rd
[*] Avoid successive refreshes of the same type of enemy
[*] In Endless Mode, active endgame is displayed as “Retreat” instead of “Sacrifice”.
[*] In Endless Mode wave 21, if you voluntarily end the game, your score will be 0 and will no longer be uploaded to the leaderboard.
[*] When an enemy is knocked back, prevent most of their body from leaving the circle, causing the player to lose damage
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed: incorrectly displaying “1” when damage numbers are too large
[*] Fixed: The frame where you pause the game, the countdown is not paused
[*] Fixed: Overflow when total damage in a single game/career exceeds program limit
[*] Fixed: Some summons not being auto-summoned when summoning too fast
[*] Fixed: Occasional inactivity of Boss Evaporater
[*] Fixed: Supergun gold mining generates a kill count.
[/list]

notes.title: V1.1.0 Change log
notes.content:
[h1]Leaderboards heading into S2 season! [/h1]
Thanks to everyone for playing and giving feedback! The game's difficulty, randomness, and balance have been tweaked quite a bit from release, as well as through your bug feedback reports.
Since the game's values have changed a lot compared to when it was released, for the sake of the fairness and fun of the leaderboards, this update will enter the S2 season of the leaderboards!
Thank you to the 6,500 players who fought on the leaderboards during the S1 season! Together we have protected the planet!
(You can go to the Leaderboards interface to switch seasons to view historical rankings)

[h1]Mechanism Adjustment[/h1]
[list]
[*] After killing a boss, the remaining time will be converted into money: 2 money/sec.
[*] Blood growth rate of gold mines in Endless Trials halved
[*] At the end of each wave, bullets present can be ejected up to one more time to avoid lag in the store screen
[/list]

[h1] Component and tech adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] Super Gun: Lv.3 Superguns have a count limit of 100=>150 per wave, Lv.4 Superguns have a count limit of 150=>333 per wave
[*] Super Link: can now be repurchased and stacked up to 5 times
[*] Accelerator: -10% => -20% cooldown remaining on summons when bullet change is complete
[*] Turret Core: Increases the life of the turret in the center of the shield by 50% => 100%.
[*] Shield Core: Shield knockback distance in the center of the turret is increased by 50% => 100%.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix: Severe lag when selling valuable components
[*] Fix: Some moons/enemies not cleared when component ring is large
[*] Fixed: Blood level of some enemies is abnormal after 90 waves in Endless Mode.
[*] Fixed: Endless Mode value anomaly that prevented score uploading
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.6 Change log
notes.content:
[h1]New pre-requisites for some technologies[/h1]
New pre-requisites for some techs to shrink the random pool and reduce randomness
[list]
[*] All-in: hold at least 100 money
[*] Refinement Restruction: hold at least 100 money
[*] Refinement Breakthrough: Hold at least 60 money
[*] Gold Technology: Hold at least 60 coins.
[*] Refinement Amplification: Hold at least 40 money.
[*] Mini-Support: Warehouse is empty
[*] Super Reserve: Warehouse is not empty.
[*] Warehouse gold: Warehouse is not empty.
[*] Lucky Reserves: Warehouse is not empty.
[*] Mod Reserve: Warehouse not empty
[*] Circular Economy: Component ring occupancy exceeds 50 percent
[*] Deep structure: component ring occupancy exceeds 50%.
[*] Streamlined Construction: component ring occupancy is less than 70% [*] Deep construction: component ring occupancy is more than 50%
[/list]

[h1]Technological adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] Oversized Magazine: adds more magazine capacity, 10=>15
[*] HP amplification: no longer reduces knockback
[/list]

[h1]Other adjustments[/h1]
[list]
[*] When disabling causes a shortage of refreshable components, the store will refresh additional techs and vice versa
[*] Damage per second is displayed with a thousand separator.
[/list]

[h1]BUG Fix[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Elite monsters on hit swipe appear more than 2 at once
[*] Fixed: Endless Mode sacrifice stats as failure in career
[*] Fixed: Gold Mines abnormally disappearing after about 90 waves.
[*] Fixed: Characters dying with half life tech when they only have 1 max life
[*] Fixed: Occasionally, at the end of a wave, you can't access the store and the game won't proceed.
[*] Fixed: Some text errors
[/list]

notes.title: V1.0.5 Change log
notes.content:
[h1]Difficulty adjustment[/h1]
[list]
[*] Difficulty 1 through Difficulty 3 reduces enemy spawn rate
[*] Difficulty 1 through Difficulty 5 reduces enemy blood/damage
[*] For Elite monsters that swipe while wounded, limit their maximum number of simultaneous presence to 2 to improve the stability of the gun school in Endless Mode
[/list]

[h1]Probability optimization[/h1]
[list]
[*] Add pre-requisites to some components/technologies to avoid refreshing them in the store when they are not needed for the current playthrough
[*] Avoid frequent reappearance of unneeded components/technologies:
[list]
[*] If you skip buying a component, the next 10 components that appear in the store will all be different (unless there are less than 10 components available).
[*] If you skip buying a tech, the next 25 techs that appear in the store will be different (unless there are less than 25 techs available)
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Technology intensity adjustment[/h1]
[list]
[*] Excessive Refresh: Reduce the number of refreshes required, need 4=>3 refreshes to get a refresh discount
[*] Super Refresh: Reduce the number of refreshes required, need 5=>4 refreshes to get attribute enhancement
[*] Super Armor: Increase the permanent damage increase benefit of uninjured damage in this wave, +3% damage increase => 5% damage increase
[*] Death Rocket: Reduce the size of Death Rocket, but increase the damage of it, every time you trigger the firearm component, increase the size by 3%=>2%, increase the damage by 6%=>15%.
[/list]

[h1]BUG Fix[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix for time passing too slowly on quick restarts
[/list]

notes.title: SHOOPER NOVA Updates - February 20, 2025
notes.content:
Attention:
- Due to significant version changes, this demo update will reset saved files :(
- Good news: Full game release will inherit save files from this version!
 
Major Updates:
- Added XBox/PlayStation controller support.
- Save functionality enabled for battles.
- Enhanced visuals for scenes and UI!
 
Other Updates:
- Added a beginner tutorial.
- Removed "Supplement Packs" from shops with direct item purchases.
- Adjusted initial techs available in the Demo and modified some random techs.
- Main character now has more expressive animations and glances around :3
- Difficulty rebalancing.
- Increased coins earned per turn.
- Enriched informational tooltips.
